coverage_note: Initial reviewed archive, incomplete. Registry facts cover every registration; portraits and non-registry sources are added only when reviewed.

title.ht: Enskripsyon pou prezidan: lis preliminè 17 Oktòb la
title.en: Presidential registrations: the preliminary list on 17 October

summary.ht: Atik sa a site non moun nan nan yon lis preliminè enskripsyon pou prezidan. Se yon atik achiv; chif li yo pa ranplase done KEP ki pi resan yo.
summary.en: This report names the person in a preliminary presidential registration list. It is an archive item; its figures do not replace the newer CEP snapshot.

title.ht: Etzer Emile anonse kandidati li

summary.ht: Nan kominike sa a, kanpay Etzer Emile anonse kandidati li epi prezante sekirite, travay ak jistis sosyal kòm angajman li. Se deklarasyon kanpay la.
summary.en: This campaign release announces Etzer Emile’s candidacy and presents security, work and social justice as commitments. These are campaign statements.

title.ht: Priyorite kanpay Etzer Emile yo

summary.ht: Paj kanpay la prezante priyorite kandida a. Li dwe li kòm pwopozisyon kanpay, pa kòm rezilta ki deja reyalize.
summary.en: The campaign page presents the candidate’s priorities. Read them as campaign proposals, not as results already achieved.

title.en: The Facebook account linked by the campaign

summary.ht: Sit kanpay la bay lyen kont sa a. Sa se yon lyen kont, li pa yon piblikasyon presi ni yon verifikasyon tout deklarasyon ki sou kont lan.

title.ht: Pwodiksyon siwo myèl nan komin Milo

summary.ht: Yon videyo nan achiv piblik Etzer Emile prezante pwodiksyon siwo myèl nan komin Milo. Li parèt nan pwòp achiv videyo li; se pa yon analiz endepandan sou kandidati li.
summary.en: A video in Etzer Emile’s public archive features honey production in Milot. It appears in his own video archive and is not an independent assessment of his candidacy.

title.ht: Mesaj Etzer Emile pou premye Janvye 2026

summary.ht: Mesaj pou premye Janvye 2026 ki parèt nan achiv videyo piblik Etzer Emile. Dat piblikasyon orijinal la poko etabli nan dosye nou an.
summary.en: A New Year 2026 message listed in Etzer Emile’s public video archive. The original publication date has not yet been established in our record.

title.ht: Prezantasyon Jude Elie sou sit li

summary.ht: Sit Jude Elie prezante pakou li ak angajman politik li. Se prezantasyon moun nan ak ekip li, li pa yon biyografi endepandan.
summary.en: Jude Elie’s website presents his background and political commitments. This is a presentation by the person and his team, not an independent biography.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau prezante priyorite li

summary.ht: Juno7 rapòte Olivier Barrau mete sekirite, edikasyon ak travay nan sant priyorite li. Atik la fè diferans ant angajman yo ak mezi ki poko detaye yo.
summary.en: Juno7 reports that Olivier Barrau emphasizes security, education and employment, and distinguishes those commitments from measures that are not yet detailed.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu depoze dokiman pou kandidati li

summary.ht: Le Nouvelliste rapòte Jerry Tardieu te depoze dokiman pou kandidati prezidansyèl li nan BED Lwès 1 nan dat 2 Novanm 2026. Depo sa a pa yon desizyon final KEP sou validasyon.
summary.en: Le Nouvelliste reports that Jerry Tardieu filed presidential candidacy documents at BED Ouest 1 on 2 November 2026. Filing is not a final CEP validation decision.

tardieu-campaign-release.publisher: En Avant pour Haïti · Le Nouvelliste

title.ht: Deklarasyon kandidati Jerry Tardieu

summary.ht: Le Nouvelliste pibliye yon kominike En Avant pour Haïti sou anons kandidati Jerry Tardieu nan dat 21 Oktòb 2026. Paj la make kòm yon tèks yo mande pibliye, se pa yon atik analiz endepandan.
summary.en: Le Nouvelliste carries an En Avant pour Haïti release about Jerry Tardieu’s announcement on 21 October 2026. The page is labeled a requested insertion, not independent analysis.

title.ht: Gary Bodeau: depo pyès yo te anonse pou 29 Oktòb
title.en: Gary Bodeau: document filing announced for 29 October

summary.ht: Nan atik 27 Oktòb la, Juno7 anonse Gary Bodeau te prevwa depoze pyès li nan dat 29 Oktòb. Atik la pa konfime KEP te valide kandidati li.
summary.en: In its 27 October report, Juno7 says Gary Bodeau planned to submit his documents on 29 October. This report does not establish CEP validation.

title.ht: Pwojè refòm Déus Deronneth anonse a

summary.ht: Pati atik Le Nouvelliste ki vizib pou tout moun prezante kandidati Déus Deronneth ak volonte li anonse pou transfòme leta epi rebati relasyon ant sitwayen yo ak enstitisyon yo.
summary.en: Le Nouvelliste’s public excerpt introduces Déus Deronneth’s candidacy and his stated aim of reforming the state and rebuilding its relationship with citizens.

title.ht: ANF chwazi Gandhy Dorfeuille

summary.ht: VeliPost rapòte ANF chwazi Gandhy Dorfeuille pou reprezante pati a nan eleksyon prezidansyèl la, dapre yon kominike 14 Septanm. Chwa yon pati pa yon validasyon KEP.
summary.en: VeliPost reports ANF’s selection of Gandhy Dorfeuille for the presidential race, citing a 14 September party release. A party’s selection is distinct from CEP validation.

title.ht: Sol Ayiti chwazi Moïse Durocher

summary.ht: Équilibre Presse rapòte Moïse Durocher genyen primè Sol Ayiti te òganize nan dat 21 Septanm, dapre rezilta gwoupman an. Se yon chwa entèn, pa yon desizyon validasyon KEP.
summary.en: Équilibre Presse reports that Moïse Durocher won Sol Ayiti’s 21 September primary, according to the group’s results. This is an internal selection, not a CEP validation decision.

title.ht: Joanas Gué enskri sou non KAPAB

summary.ht: Le Tout Au Pluriel Magazine rapòte Joanas Gué fè enskripsyon li sou entènèt nan dat 9 Oktòb sou non KAPAB. Atik la prezante tou eksperyans li kòm ansyen minis Agrikilti. Enskripsyon pa vle di validasyon.
summary.en: Le Tout Au Pluriel Magazine reports Joanas Gué’s online registration on 9 October under KAPAB and describes his previous role as agriculture minister. Registration does not establish validation.

title.ht: AJKN mande Wilson Jeudy kite pòs majistra li
title.en: AJKN calls for Wilson Jeudy to leave his mayoral post

summary.ht: Le Reflet rapòte AJKN mande Wilson Jeudy kite pòs majistra Delmas li pandan li kandida pou prezidan. Se yon atik sou revandikasyon òganizasyon an, pa yon desizyon otorite elektoral.
summary.en: Le Reflet reports AJKN’s demand that Wilson Jeudy leave his Delmas mayoral post while pursuing the presidency. This covers the organisation’s demand, not an electoral ruling.

title.ht: EDE chwazi Claude Joseph

summary.ht: Juno7 rapòte biwo politik EDE a chwazi Claude Joseph nan dat 17 Septanm pou reprezante pati a nan eleksyon prezidansyèl la. Se desizyon pati a; li pa ranplase validasyon KEP.
summary.en: Juno7 reports EDE’s political bureau selected Claude Joseph on 17 September to represent the party in the presidential race. The party’s decision does not replace CEP validation.

title.ht: Maxo Joseph prezante objektif li pou otorite leta
title.en: Maxo Joseph outlines his aim of restoring state authority

summary.ht: Pati atik Le Nouvelliste ki vizib pou tout moun prezante Maxo Joseph sou non RCH ak volonte li anonse pou retabli otorite leta. Li baze sou yon entèvyou 24 Septanm.
summary.en: Le Nouvelliste’s public excerpt presents Maxo Joseph’s candidacy under RCH and his stated aim of restoring state authority, based on a 24 September interview.

title.ht: Wilner Joseph mete rekonsilyasyon nasyonal devan
title.en: Wilner Joseph puts forward national reconciliation

summary.ht: Pati atik Le Nouvelliste ki vizib pou tout moun prezante Wilner Joseph sou non Viktwa, eksperyans politik li ak mesaj rekonsilyasyon nasyonal li a. Se prezantasyon objektif li, pa yon evalyasyon rezilta.
summary.en: Le Nouvelliste’s public excerpt presents Wilner Joseph under Viktwa, his political background and his national reconciliation message. It describes his stated aims, not an assessment of results.

title.ht: Michel Martelly enskri sou non DEBLOKE

summary.ht: Juno7 rapòte Michel Martelly enskri sou non DEBLOKE epi li raple kèk etap nan pakou politik li. Atik la presize enskripsyon an pa yon validasyon definitif kandidati li.
summary.en: Juno7 reports Michel Martelly’s registration under DEBLOKE and outlines his political background. The report explicitly distinguishes registration from final validation of his candidacy.

title.ht: MPH prezante kandida li yo

summary.ht: Paj pati MPH la prezante kandida li yo, foto yo ak pòs yo vle okipe. Se yon lis pati a pibliye li menm; se pa lis kandida KEP valide a.
summary.en: MPH’s own page presents its candidates, portraits and the offices they seek. This is a self-published party listing, not the CEP’s validated candidate list.

title.ht: Septanm: FCN ap chèche sipò Jean Ernest Muscadin
title.en: September: FCN seeks Jean Ernest Muscadin’s support

summary.ht: Nan atik achiv 13 Septanm sa a, Juno7 rapòte FCN t ap eseye konvenk Jean Ernest Muscadin pou reprezante li. Nan moman piblikasyon an, atik la pa t rapòte okenn anons kote li aksepte.
summary.en: In this 13 September archive report, Juno7 describes FCN’s efforts to persuade Jean Ernest Muscadin to represent it. At publication, no announcement accepting the proposal was reported.

title.ht: Jocelerme Privert anonse depo dosye li ak priyorite li
title.en: Jocelerme Privert announces filing and priorities

summary.ht: Juno7 rapòte Jocelerme Privert anonse li te depoze dosye li sou non AYITI TRANSFÒME nan dat 19 Oktòb. Atik la prezante sekirite, jistis ak pwodiksyon nasyonal kòm priyorite li anonse.
summary.en: Juno7 reports Jocelerme Privert’s announcement that he filed under AYITI TRANSFÒME on 19 October, and describes security, justice and national production as his stated priorities.

title.ht: René St Fort pale sou eleksyon ak lavi chè
title.en: René St Fort discusses elections and living costs

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte yon entèvyou kote René St Fort eksprime enkyetid li sou reta nan pwosesis elektoral la ak konsekans pri gaz yo. Se pozisyon li te eksprime nan mwa Avril.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports an interview in which René St Fort raises concerns about electoral delays and the effects of fuel prices. These are positions expressed in April.

title.ht: Pòtrè kanpay Etzer Emile pou laprès

summary.ht: Paj pou laprès ki sou sit kanpay Etzer Emile la bay pòtrè kanpay la pibliye. Sa a se sous foto a, se pa yon atik analiz endepandan.
summary.en: The press page on Etzer Emile’s campaign website provides campaign portraits. This is the photo source, not an independent analysis article.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu anonse kandidati li ak En Avant
title.en: Jerry Tardieu announces his candidacy with En Avant

summary.ht: Juno7 rapòte Jerry Tardieu anonse kandidati li sou non En Avant pour Haïti nan dat 21 Oktòb. Atik la prezante sekirite ak travay kòm priyorite li anonse.
summary.en: Juno7 reports Jerry Tardieu’s 21 October candidacy announcement under En Avant pour Haïti and presents security and jobs as his stated priorities.

title.ht: OPL chwazi Jean-Marie Junior Salomon

summary.ht: InfoLigne rapòte OPL chwazi Jean-Marie Junior Salomon nan dat 24 Oktòb pou reprezante li nan eleksyon prezidansyèl la. Atik la rapòte tou demann pati a pou fasilite demach administratif kandida yo.
summary.en: InfoLigne reports OPL’s selection of Jean-Marie Junior Salomon on 24 October for the presidential race and the party’s request to ease candidates’ administrative procedures.
